task_instance: Build a sales-ready battlecard for a named competitor (Orbit CRM, competing against a sample company Nimbus CRM) from a set of realistic raw competitive-intel notes (changelog, G2 reviews, pricing intel, funding news, hiring signals, win/loss interview notes, feature comparison), following the skill's Layer 2 tracking dimensions, Layer 3 SWOT/feature-gap analysis, and Layer 4 battlecard output format.
evidence: Created sample_input.md with realistic raw intel (changelog note, G2 review signals, pricing change, funding round, hiring signals, 2 loss interviews and 3 win interviews, informal feature comparison) for a fictional competitor Orbit CRM vs our fictional product Nimbus CRM. Produced battlecard-orbit-crm.md covering: Snapshot (threat tier, pricing, funding, win rate), Recent Moves, Why We Win, Why We Lose, Objection Handling table, Feature Gap Table, and Recommended Actions mapped to the skill's triggered-response cadence (funding->48hr assessment, feature launch->1wk response, pricing change->1wk response, recurring loss reason->CPO escalation). Verified the deliverable exists and is complete via `wc -l` (52 lines) and `grep -E '^## '` confirming all 7 expected sections are present, and manually cross-checked every claim in the battlecard traces back to a specific line in sample_input.md (no fabricated data). This is a pure content-generation/document deliverable requiring no external tools, network access, or credentials, so no runtime limitation was encountered.
